            @"I skip subsequent steps if table ""(.*)"" is not present in the comparison database for both master and comparison environments")]
        [StepDefinitionDescription(Documentation =
            "Cause the rest of the test not to run if the specified table is not present in the comparison database for the two environments.  This is useful if comparing data then may not be present in the source environments and therefore the tables will not be created in the comparison database.  This avoids a false test failure whereby the SQL fails with a 'table does not exist' error")]
        public void
            GivenISkipSubsequentStepsIfTableIsNotPresentInTheComparisonDatabaseForBothMasterAndComparisonEnvironments(
                string tableName)
        {
            if (!_comparisonDb.Value.TableExists(tableName, MasterEnv) &&
                !_comparisonDb.Value.TableExists(tableName, TestEnv))
                StepLog.Ignore($"{tableName} is absent for both {MasterEnv} and {TestEnv}");
        }
